- SSO/SAML configuration details (IdP metadata, ACS URLs)

Hi Lisa,

Thanks for the clear list — happy to get these over. Attaching an initial package to this email: sso-setup-guide.pdf (SAML metadata + example IdP config) and scim-provisioning-matrix.csv (attribute mappings and required claims). I've cc'd Aditya and Dev to provide the RBAC screenshots and answers about MFA/privileged account controls.

Quick notes:
- Redwood supports SAML 2.0 and OIDC; the PDF contains IdP metadata and ACS endpoints for hosted and dedicated deployments.
- SCIM v2 is supported for most customer directories; the CSV lists supported attributes and which are user-provisioned vs. system-managed.
- For RBAC, we have coarse-grained roles by default (admin, developer, viewer) and fine-grained tenant scoping for Dedicated/Private. See upcoming note from Aditya for a policy screenshot.
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II in 2026-09; we'll attach the cover letter and can provide full report under NDA.
- HIPAA/BAA: Redwood does offer a BAA for customers under enterprise contracts. I can loop our legal if you'd like pre-signed language or we can push a DocuSign BAA once the contract team is engaged.

Next steps: If the attachments look sufficient, can you confirm which two artifacts you want as part of your audit packet (we usually provide SAML metadata, SCIM mapping, RBAC policies, and SOC 2 cover letter)? Also, are there any format preferences (PDF, spreadsheet) for uploads to your evidence portal?

Best,

Hi Lisa — quick follow-up with the technical details on RBAC and admin controls.

On Tue, Aug 1, 2027 at 10:38 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick notes:
> - For RBAC, we have coarse-grained roles by default (admin, developer, viewer) and fine-grained tenant scoping for Dedicated/Private.

To expand:
- Roles: Admin (manage users, bind roles, manage billing), Developer (deploy models, create routes), Viewer (read-only logs/metrics).
- Role bindings: scoped at organization and project levels; admins can be restricted to org-level only where required.
- Privileged access controls: Admin accounts require enforced MFA (TOTP or FIDO2) and are subject to monthly access reviews.
- Session and audit: Admin actions are logged to our audit stream (immutable) with user, ip, timestamp, and action details.
- SCIM provisioning notes: we support group-to-role mapping; the CSV Marissa attached includes recommended group names.

Attaching RBAC policy screenshot (rbac-policy-screenshot.png) and a short diagram in the Drive link Marissa shared. If useful, we can schedule a 30-min technical walkthrough with your engineering team.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Staff Engineer, Infra | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

Attachments: rbac-policy-screenshot.png
